faq_heading: Homes near Delta Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Delta Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Delta Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Delta Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Delta Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ladner Elementary (0.5 km south-west), Delta Christian School (0.6 km north-east) and Port Guichon Elementary (1.2 km west).

Delta Secondary is a secondary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 4615 51 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Delta Secondary.
How the Delta Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Delta Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Delta Secondary

8 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Delta Secondary in a straight line (7 elementary, 1 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is Ladner Elementary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Neilson Grove Elementary, 2.4 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delta Access (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Delta Christian School (0.6 km).

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Delta Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Delta Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Delta Secondary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at Delta Access, the nearest other secondary school, 1.4 km east of Delta Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
